plan: My private value is $22. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid your true value. This prevents potentially losing out on a profitable opportunity by bidding too low. Since values are independently drawn and this is a single round, I'll bid close to my actual value. I'll bid slightly below $22 to create some strategic margin, aiming to win if others bid lower while protecting against overpaying.

My private value is $34. My goal is to maximize potential profit. Since the prize is worth $34 to me, I want to bid strategically to win only if I can do so without paying more than my value. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A bid around $32-$33 gives me a chance to win while protecting against overpaying. This allows potential profit if I win and minimizes loss if I don't.
